$description: DELTA Resilience brand primitives — the single source Mangrove builds from. W3C DTCG design-token format (https://tr.designtokens.org/format/). Every consuming file is generated by `node scripts/build-tokens.cjs`; nothing here is duplicated by hand anywhere else in the repo. Add a value once, declare where it should surface in `$extensions`, rebuild.

primary.$description: UNDRR Blue. DELTA's own design system labels this swatch "UNDRR Blue - Corporate blue" and marks it Brand. 54 uses in DELTA's code, 1551 fills and 1645 strokes in its Figma file. It is rgb(0 79 145), identical to Mangrove's --mg-color-blue-900: DELTA's brand blue is UNDRR's. Interactive colour: links, buttons, tabs, focus, tags.

primary-800.$description: Hover/active partner of the brand blue, 9 uses in DELTA. Note it is LIGHTER than the base colour, unlike Mangrove's convention of darkening on hover. That is DELTA's actual behaviour, not an error.

card-surface.$description: Card / subtle surface fill. #f2f2f2 appears 11 times in DELTA; #fafafa, which Mangrove previously guessed, appears once.

secondary.$description: UNDRR Teal, DELTA's secondary brand colour. Mangrove previously mapped the secondary button to the same blue as the primary, collapsing a genuine two-colour brand into one.

secondary-800.$description: Hover partner of UNDRR Teal, taken one step DOWN the teal ramp in DELTA's design file (#002323 #004646 #006968 #007B7A #00AFAE). DELTA's stylesheet uses #359999 here, a step UP, but white text on that is 3.40:1 and fails WCAG 1.4.3. #006968 is 6.52:1 and comes from DELTA's own ramp, so this is a deliberate, sourced divergence rather than an invented colour - the same call already made for DELTA's field border.

family-base.$description: DELTA body typeface. The @font-face src URLs are an asset declaration, not a token, and stay hand-written in aria/_tokens-delta.scss.
